snippet.title: POPGOES Arcade: Fighting Chance OUT NOW
snippet.description:
Buy POPGOES Arcade: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1986840/POPGOES_Arcade/

Fighting Chance, a FREE major update for POPGOES Arcade, is now available. We have overhauled the core gameplay by introducing new mechanics and reworking old features. If you're new to the series, this is the perfect time to jump in. And if you've already completed POPGOES Arcade before, here is your excuse to revisit the game to see how much nicer it is.

Have fun!
